Key points
• To review history and current pregnancy weight gain recommendations.
• To discuss consequences of excessive and inadequate weight gain for maternal and child health.
• To identify research gaps and opportunities.
Glossary
Body Mass Index Weight (in kg) divided by height (in meters squared). Used as an indicator of undernutrition or overweight
Gestational diabetes mellitus Abnormal glucose metabolism accompanied by major alterations in the metabolism of fat and
protein. Diagnosed by high blood glucose and/or urinary glucose. This is the most common medical disorder in pregnancy
High birth weight (macrosomia) >4500 g
Low birth weight (LBW) <250
